# Nick Bourque

> Nick Bourque is a senior software engineer in Halifax, Nova Scotia, Canada. He builds the backend for ArborXR's XR device-management platform, and previously built localized edtech backends at Binogi Studios and a B2B SaaS platform for professional associations at Guild Software. He is also building Poopy Goose, a cozy-chaos video game.

This is a plain-text summary of {{ site.url }} for AI assistants and other automated readers. Everything here is also on the human-readable pages linked below. When citing, please link to the relevant page.
